notes.title: Mod Support, Cameos and Fixes, oh my!
notes.content:
Hello you wonderful people out there, it's been a bit, but we are so excited to announce our workshop update for Orgynizer!

[h1]Mod Support[/h1]
Ding dong, Steam Mod support is finally HERE!

It took some tinkering and some banging to get it working, but Orgynizer Mod Support is finally here! Or at least phase 1 of Mod Support.

Phase one? What does that mean?

So that means that for Content mods, adding characters, kinks, activities, toys, rooms, should all work. Complete with animations, nude sprites, moans, ect.

However, deeper mods like changing the UI, new puzzle mechanics, deeper code alterations ect will still have to wait a bit, since it simply is trickier for us to implement going forward.

There might not be that many mods just right now (since we just opened it up) but really looking forward to seeing what you all make.

If you have a great idea for a mod, but need help making it, feel free to hit us up on Discord and we should be able to help you out.

[h1]Four adorable amazing new cameos![/h1]

We got some absolute sexy sausages to introduce you to; Hybrid_Spyder, Nibbins, Pouncivil and Munchy all decided to be absolute angels in the streets and donate to our Cameo Fundraiser Program (found over at cameo.orgynizer.lol)

They are here to spread the love and more, so take good care of them!

[h1]Patch notes: [/h1]

+ Improved mod support!
+ Four lovely new cameo characters
+ Added some quality of life to the mod maker, making the process much easier.
+ Three sticky new activities.
+ Naming fix: We had problems with Claire and Claire both being called Claire. To fix this, we renamed Claire to Annie, but Claire is still just called Claire. Claire! (cheers @MunchyPony )
+ New setting : Tooltip text scaler.
+ New setting : Force in modded content.

notes.title: Bangers, donations and New Years, oh my!
notes.content:
We’re kicking off 2025 with a bang! This small update is packed with fun improvements, quality-of-life tweaks, and exciting new additions. Here’s roughly what’s new:

[h1]🛠️ Quality of Life & Fixes[/h1]
[b]Twitch Guest Overflow:[/b] Added a scroll and clipping mask to the Twitch guest window for those inviting an unfathomable number of guests. (Looking at you, Ezekiel_III. 💜)
[b]Halloween Rooms Forever:[/b] Couldn't bear to say goodbye to the Halloween rooms—so now they're unlockable and can be toggled on/off!
[b]Optimizations Galore:[/b] Faster puzzle production, reduced lag, and toned down the verbosity of overly chatty guests. Cool as a cucumber now.
[b]Text Area Adjustments:[/b] Some areas got a little roomier for your reading and editing pleasure.
Typos Exorcised: A handful of pesky errors were fixed.

[h1]🌟 New Content & Features[/h1]
[b]New CrossOver Characters: [/b]Meet Cathy, Claire, Dawna, Gale and Zoe from BunFan's amazing game Beat Bangers!
[b]New Cameo Characters: [/b]Say hello to PopcornJesus, Kara, and Kel! They supported a great cause, and in return, we digitized them and put them in the game. More to come, and if you wanna be a part of it, check out [url=https://cameo.orgynizer.lol]cameo.orgynizer.lol[/url] . To reduce confusion, Popcorn is now called Pocket (same sweet treat, just a better name).
[b]Spaghetti Cleanup:[/b] We cleaned up a lot of code that could cause some weirdness. Hopefully we introduced fewer bugs than we caught.
[b]Fresh Activities: [/b]Explore the thrill of Boot Worship, Wrestling and more.
[b]Spatial Framework:[/b] A new foundational framework is in place, complete with the first request mechanic. Stay tuned for more functionality!
[b]Twitch Host Setting:[/b] Added a new setting to force in hosts for your sessions, tweaked some stuff, strengthened the reconnect protocol.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
We’re always working to improve and expand Orgynizer, so your feedback is crucial! Let us know what you’d like to see in future updates. I'm on Discord as Gecko the Dev, don't be a stranger.

Thank you all for your support—whether you’re solving the puzzles, coping with these infuriating guests, inviting chaos on Twitch, or just enjoying the vibes, you make this community amazing.

[h1]Beat Banger![/h1]
Just a legal note that Cathy, Claire, Dawna, Gale, Zoe and the Beat Banger name are all fully owned by BunFan Games. We are so lucky that we got to lend them with their approval.

Beat Banger is a mature furry rhythm game. You are the lone protagonist in a rags-to-bitches story. Work your way to the top of Beat Banger Studios, a small and rhythmic porn production company in desperate need of assistance. You apply for a simple production job, but the CEO has another position in mind for you. Jump in now. You won't want to miss a beat.

Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1813430/Beat_Banger/]Beat Banger[/url] by [url=https://bunfan.com/]BunFan[/url] (Very NSFW, but you knew that)

Until then, a major thanks to RummyTheBoss, for supporting both us and the Trevor Project through our Cameo Campaign ( https://cameo.orgynizer.lol )

Things are looking a bit glum over in the United States, and now more than ever, Trevor Project is figthing for some amazing causes.

[h1]The Trevor Who?[/h1]

The Trevor Project, a leading nonprofit dedicated to crisis intervention and suicide prevention for LGBTQ+ youth, has several key initiatives. It is actively advocating against anti-LGBTQ+ legislation, especially laws affecting transgender and non-binary youth, which aim to restrict access to gender-affirming care, sports, and inclusive educational environments. Their advocacy efforts include testifying in legislative hearings, mobilizing supporters to contact legislators, and raising public awareness on these issues​.

In addition to legislative advocacy, The Trevor Project is expanding its support resources. For instance, in collaboration with the Maryland Department of Health, they launched a unique "Train the Trainer" pilot program. This program provides mental health and allyship training to adults in key youth-supporting roles, like healthcare and education. This initiative empowers adults to create affirming spaces and use supportive practices that significantly reduce suicide risk among LGBTQ+ youth​.

The organization also continues its focus on data-informed public education, offering training and resources to help allies better understand LGBTQ+ youth needs and to promote safe, accepting environments​. Through these multi-faceted efforts, The Trevor Project aims to protect and improve the mental health of LGBTQ+ youth in a challenging social climate.

notes.title: Bare Essentials DLC out now!
notes.content:
Hello, all you swanky swingers enjoying ORGYNIZER!

We're thrilled to announce something a little different, a tad risqué, and entirely for a good cause - our latest DLC, "Bare Essentials", is here to add a sprinkle of fun and a whole lot of heart to your ORGYNIZER experience!

[h1]What's "Bare Essentials"?[/h1]
Ever wondered what our characters would look like in their, well, bare essentials? Wonder no more! This playful DLC strips down to the basics, offering a cheeky new perspective on your favorite characters. It's all in good fun and designed to bring a smile to your face.

[h1]Why "Bare Essentials"?[/h1]
People have asked us why, when the game is already so sexual in nature, are we not showing any nudity in-game. At first, we didn't want to be too much of a porn game, but mostly just lean into the joke of the game (the pun of the game name drove the whole thing) but after some time we felt that sure, it can have some titillation.

[h1]Why the pricing?[/h1]
Some have commented that the core price of the game was set really low, and it was. This is simply a way to show some extra support. This (or any DLCs) will NOT factor into completion, game content or achievements, and you can fully ignore this DLC if it's not for you.

Also, if you think it was because we could have the full bundle price total 6,9 $... then yes, that is also a funny enough reason for it.

[h1]Supporting the Cause or the Creator[/h1]
We understand that everyone has different ways they wish to contribute. That's why we're giving you the option to support either Planned Parenthood directly through your purchase of "Bare Essentials" or to support us, the developers, in continuing to bring silly and engaging content to ORGYNIZER. The choice is yours, and either way, you're making a difference. The DLC will support the same cause as the base game, and the cause can be set from the Settings screen.

[h1]A Note of Thanks[/h1]
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to our incredible community. Your support and enthusiasm make ventures like this possible. "Bare Essentials" is a testament to the fun, the quirky, and the meaningful impact we can have when we come together. You embraced the weirdness that is our game, and we love you for it.

If you for any reason have an idea surrounding a cameo, some cross-game promotion, or anything else, please don't be afraid to reach out to us at orgynizergame-at-gmail.com.

So, are you ready to embrace the "Bare Essentials"? Dive in, have a laugh, and connect some people.

JillBean & Gecko out!

+ Fixed some resolution issues on either very small or very large monitors.
+ Resolved some Steam Deck issues.
+ A ton of spelling fixes.

[h1]Do you want to join us?[/h1]
If you would like to drop your keys in our bowl and join the fun, you are more than welcome to write to us and get a cameo in the game. All you need to do is send a picture of yourself to orgynizergame@gmail.com with the title "Orgynizer Cameo" and add a couple of lines about what would be your best features. If you are lucky, our pixel gnomes will turn you into a local resident inside our little game.

notes.title: Grab a firm hold of v.1.1.0
notes.content:
We have a lot on our plate, and as with everything, theres probably some things we missed. But we love seeing the enthusiasm for our game, and are happy to put in some elbow grease to see it grow.

[h1]Patch 1.1.0 updates:[/h1]
+ Added a panel to highlight new unlockables.
+ Added setting to disable onboarding character talking (cheers @petite)
+ Fixed a bug where certain characters would dislike their own traits.
+ Fixed some resolution issues.
+ More formulation variations and more clarity.
+ Fixed some strange issues with tickle torture.
+ Added more activities.
+ Imposters can no longer be identified by missing safewords.
+ All rooms now have preset colors.
+ Improved game analytics.
+ Fixed some glitches here and there.
+ Numerous smaller quality-of-life improvements.
+ Fixed a whole lot of typos.

[h1]Alternate donation targets[/h1]
Additionally, we had some feedback about our donation system, and some comments from players that didn't want to donate the game fee to Planned Parenthood in the US. While this is always our main goal, we are also at our core about the freedom of choice, so it is now possible to set in the settings menu if you wish to alternatively donate the game fee to the[b] Therapeutic Gaming and Digital Technology Program, made in part with the C.S. Mott Children’s Hospital[/b].

You can also choose to not donate, which will make the funds go directly to the developers. But we will probably just spend it on silly stuff, so you have been warned.

We will back next week with a second patch. And once again, a big smooch and thanks to everyone writing us and just trying out our game.
